messages:
jamie_cs: Tidal Health just dropped their vendor security form during onboarding. They want DPA answers, SOC2 scope confirmation, a one-paragraph KMS/BYOK note, and a short statement on embeddings retention. Deadline = Wed midday.
uploads-bot: uploaded tidal_vendor_form_v3.pdf (shared)
amy_product: FYI renewal conversation is scheduled in 7 days. CS — can we get this into the onboarding tracker ASAP?
jamie_cs: yes — priority is: 1) DPA Qs 2) KMS attestation (hosted vs dedicated) 3) embeddings retention defaults + pseudonymization option 4) nonprod access controls. They specifically call out wanting rotation cadence and whether audit logs are available for review.
rachel_security: I'll draft an attestation. Suggest keep it consumer-friendly. Quick Q: should we offer to provide redacted CloudTrail snippets or just confirm logging and retention? (CloudTrail snippets require security review.)
devon_infra: ops note: we can provide redacted examples but need SOC2-approved release. Default answer: logs retained per our retention policy and available for customer review under an NDA/inspection request.
amy_product: include the policy line and offer next steps if they want evidence — that'll push to legal/security for sign-off.
rachel_security: drafting: "Redwood Inference encrypts customer data at rest using HSM-backed key management. For Hosted deployments, keys are managed by Redwood; for Dedicated and Private deployments, customers may provide BYOK and we supply integration guidance. Keys are rotated annually or immediately after any suspected compromise; all key operations are logged and retained in our centralized audit system. Redacted key provenance samples can be supplied under an evidence request."
jamie_cs: good. embeddings retention: what's the short default line?
devon_infra: Hosted embeddings default retention: 30 days for transient vectors unless customer requests custom retention. Dedicated/Private: configurable per contract. For pseudonymization: we can support salted hashing before storage but it affects search quality — mention tradeoffs.
amy_product: add: "We can provide guidance for privacy-preserving hashing workflows if required."
jamie_cs: added. Also they asked about nonprod access controls — quick one-liner?
rachel_security: "Non-production environments are access-restricted; developers use scoped jump boxes and credentials are rotated. Nonprod systems do not contain production tenant data unless explicitly required and approved." brief enough.
jamie_cs: perfect. I'll combine into answers doc and attach. Can someone paste a redacted key-provenance template (no real IDs)?
devon_infra: redacted example below (masking with Xs):
```
Alias: redwood-tidal-2024
KMS ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx
Created: 2023-11-02
LastRotation: 2024-11-02
RotationPolicy: annual
Notes: redacted for security
```
jamie_cs: great. Rachel — can you finalize attestation then I'll attach everything and post to the customer. Also tagging legal if they ask for audit snippets.
rachel_security: final attestation posted to thread as tidal_kms_attestation.txt
uploads-bot: uploaded files: tidal_answers_draft.txt, tidal_kms_attestation.txt, tidal_key_provenance_redacted.txt, tidal_embeddings_note.txt
amy_product: small ask — please capture whether Tidal says the answers are sufficient. We'll log any follow-up asks in the renewal risk section.
jamie_cs: will do. If they escalate BYOK or network peering we'll loop infra and sales for timeline/estimate. Posting answers now :thumbsup:
uploads-bot: tidal_answers_draft.txt (shared)
